scope: Parent targeted primary evidence for four general cohesion repairs; no fresh auditor delivery/perception or new procedure/novelty claim. Pure source auditor receives none of these repair records.

literal_passages.authority: CORE p18 operations, retained Damage and destruction Fear
literal_passages.text:
Some effects remove Invaders, representing them fleeing in terror. Return the specified pieces to the 
supply. Some replace Invaders: first you remove the Invader, then you put something else in its place. 
A replaced Invader keeps any Damage it had. More Powers destroy Invaders outright. Return the 
specified pieces to the supply. Destroying a Town generates 1 Fear and destroying a City generates 2 
Fear, but removing or replacing does not.
Whenever a Power or other effect says “Damage”, it always means “Damage to Invaders” unless 
explicitly specified otherwise. When dealing Damage, it is done to any Invaders in the target land, 
divided among them however you choose. If an Invader has taken Damage equal to or greater than 
its Health (see Invaders, page 15), it is destroyed immediately. Damage may be combined from
multiple Powers. However, any remaining Damage on survivors heals at the end of the turn.

literal_passages.authority: CORE p18 automatic Fear addition and no remove/replace Fear
literal_passages.text:
FEAR FROM DESTRUCTION
Whenever a City or Town is destroyed (via
Damage or otherwise), it frightens the Invaders.
You generate 2 Fear for each City destroyed and
1 Fear for each Town destroyed (in addition to
any Fear done explicitly by the Power).
If you remove or replace a City/Town, it does not
generate this automatic Fear.

literal_passages.authority: CORE p12 Fear generation and per-point marker movement
literal_passages.text:
FEAR AND TERROR
Fear is generated by Spirit Powers with the Fear symbol (       ) and by destruction (either directly by
an effect or by Damage): destroying a Town generates 1 Fear and destroying a City generates 2 Fear.
Fear terrifies the Invaders as a whole. For each Fear generated, advance one Fear Marker from the
Fear Pool on the Invader Board to the Generated Fear area.

literal_passages.authority: CORE p12 earning then refill before leftover Fear
literal_passages.text:
(1) When all of the Fear Markers have
advanced, (2) move the top card of
the Fear Deck face-down into the
Earned Fear Cards area. If this reveals
a Terror Level divider, move it to cover
the old Terror Level (which starts at
Level 1, preprinted on the board). 
(3) Move the Fear Markers back to the
Fear Pool; if you have leftover Fear
after earning a card, move that many 
Fear Markers to the Generated Fear
area.

literal_passages.authority: FAQ Sworn to Victory unrestricted trigger and full Ravage timing
literal_passages.text:
If written today, the wording would be "After Invaders Ravage, for each Dahan destroyed in that Ravage, Destroy 1 of your Presence within Range 1.
(Resolve the entire Ravage in that land – including, if relevant, adding Blight, losing Presence to Blight, cascading, and counterattacking – before destroying Presence from this special rule.)
"

literal_passages.authority: FAQ Bringer general per-Power Fear and movement mapping
literal_passages.text: For each Power Bringer uses, briefly imagine a universe where you resolve the entire Power normally. Whenever it would destroy an Invader in that universe, in the real game you earn 0/2/5 Fear and Push it if it's an Explorer or Town.
Yes. The Repeat is considered a separate action from the original.

literal_passages.authority: FAQ immediate destruction on retained Damage/new Health
literal_passages.text: Invaders and Dahan have Health and take Damage. As soon as they have taken as much Damage as their Health, they are destroyed, whether that comes from taking more Damage or having their Health reduced.
